title: code.talks 2023 - Our journey from Gitflow to Trunk Based Development
summary: Case study of a team moving from Gitflow to trunk-based development with feature flags and ephemeral per-branch environments, reporting more frequent releases and happier developers.

assertions.quote: we spend a lot of time to handle conflicts because we have so many branches

verdicts.note: The mechanism is direct, and DORA research associates short-lived branches and trunk-based development with higher delivery performance.

DORA observes that merging patches sooner avoids rebases and that short-lived branches and small patches make everyone more productive, but it does not measure merge conflicts or how they scale with team size.

assertions.quote: it's not because you are using Jenkins GitHub gitlab Circle CI that you are doing continuous integration

verdicts.note: Matches the standard definition of continuous integration as frequent integration to a shared mainline, which tooling alone does not guarantee.

DORA defines impactful CI as every commit producing a build and test run, and separately defines effective trunk-based development as fewer than three active branches with lifetimes under a day; both predict continuous delivery, but branch lifetime is treated as a distinct capability rather than part of the definition of CI.

assertions.quote: it also allows us to increase the release frequency to have much more stable iteration

verdicts.note: DORA data correlate trunk-based development with better delivery metrics and small changes are easier to revert, but the gains are correlational and the team's own numbers are self-reported.

Survey data show trunk-based development with frequent check-in and deployment to production is predictive of software delivery performance (deploy frequency, lead time, change failure rate, time to restore); rollback ease is not measured.

assertions.quote: we are actually decoupling deployment from release

verdicts.note: A well-established mechanism used at scale by large web companies, with documented costs in flag management.

assertions.quote: they recycled an old future flag and when they turn it on the last machine that did not receive the new version

verdicts.note: The Knight Capital incident is documented in the SEC order as a repurposed flag plus an incomplete deployment, and flag hygiene guidance exists because of such cases.

assertions.quote: you need to have a pretty strong test Suite in terms of completeness a good coverage and it needs to execute fasts

verdicts.note: Practitioner accounts and DORA both treat fast automated tests as a prerequisite for continuous delivery; synchronous review is one way to meet the merge cadence but not the only one.

assertions.quote: we remove the bottleneck okay it's been completely removed

verdicts.note: The queueing mechanism is sound and widely reported, but evidence is practitioner case studies and the environments bring their own cost and data-seeding work.

assertions.quote: maybe trunk base development is not suitable for you and git flow still is a good option

verdicts.note: Release branches cut from trunk are a standard way to ship versioned products from trunk, so the limit is weaker than stated, though strict version control does reduce the practice's advantages.

DORA notes open-source releases are cut from a branch at a point in time after significant testing, a different cadence from continuous delivery, yet says short-lived branches and small patches still apply there; it does not test products with tightly controlled versions directly.

assertions.quote: they are way much happier than before when they were just like okay I finished this feature somebody else is going to validate

verdicts.note: DORA surveys associate continuous delivery with lower burnout and higher job satisfaction, but causation is not isolated and this is one team's impression.

assertions.quote: we need to remove video Flex that there is an extra cost

verdicts.note: Stale-flag debt is well documented and large companies have built tooling specifically to remove dead flags.
